title: Persist computer snapshot fields in Dynamo
description:
**Step 1 of the accepted `chatticus-fccc4e9a-b3c6-4a14-9317-d0b0c95231b7` host-disk plan.** Control-plane only. Can proceed while `chatticus-8fe4c7e1-2043-442d-bc48-5350e7995f32` is open.

Parent epic: `chatticus-598be488-151d-4e57-8897-5cf6aaed50e5`.

Persist on the Dynamo computer record: `snapshot_uri`, checksum, generation, `hydrate_required`, `intended_host_worker_id`, `disk_dirty`. Today's `put_computer` / `get_computer` omit all of them **and** omit `computer.workspace`.

**Do not persist the dict as the durable workplace.** That is the leak-without-the-benefit. Do not add a second reader. Steps 2–3 (host hydrate/publish and moving file tools onto the host) wait on a host that runs (`chatticus-8fe4c7e1-2043-442d-bc48-5350e7995f32`).

Gherkin first. Outside-in.

```
Feature: Computer snapshot fields survive a ThinTurn recycle

  Scenario: hydrate_required is still set after put_computer
    Given a computer record with snapshot_uri, checksum, generation, hydrate_required, intended_host_worker_id, and disk_dirty
    When the control plane persists it and a new process loads it
    Then those fields are the same
    And computer.workspace is not treated as the durable workplace
```

Storage discovery stays closed. Do not delete the snapshot library.

## Done when

Dynamo round-trip of those fields is specified and green. No dual reader. No host-worker wiring on this card.
